negative_control_no_horizon.interpretation: ResConv1D advantage is 2.78x LARGER without a horizon (10.66x) than with one (3.83x). The gap measures generic smooth-signal PDE interpolation capacity (GroupNorm/GELU/residual connections), not horizon-specific physics resolution.
